name: FRESHMAN: Project SEX
source:
FRESHMAN: Project SEX is an adult visual novel about university life, risky bets, and nerdy adventures. Meet campus girls from anime clubs, DnD sessions, and board game nights while trying to build your reputation on campus before the semester ends. Choices, chaos, and spicy encounters await.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4491190/FRESHMAN_Project_SEX/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《大一新生：性爱计划》是一部围绕大学校园生活、大胆赌约与宅系冒险展开的成人视觉小说。在学期结束前努力打响自己的校园名号，结识来自漫研社、《龙与地下城》跑团聚会与桌游之夜的各色校园女孩吧。多重抉择、热闹乱局与火辣艳遇正等待着你。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4491190/FRESHMAN_Project_SEX/]Steam[/url]]
